digest.component_or_area: pytest editor fixture instrumentation and observability
propositions: CPython ThreadingHTTPServer constructor synchronously calls socket.getfqdn(host) even for numeric 127.0.0.1, triggering a ~35 second reverse DNS lookup on macOS and causing test_server_binds_loopback_only to consume 35 seconds consistently across Gerrit Verify runs.

Nested instrumentation of fixture setup, editor server constructor, TCP bind, and socket.getfqdn with emission threshold of 1 second confirms getfqdn accounts for the 35-second delay while TCP bind and other operations remain sub-second.

Instrumentation is gated by CI environment variable or explicit REBAR_FIXTURE_TIMING=1 opt-in, wraps callables transparently without changing return values or exception identity, and remains silent below threshold.

Dynamic timing evidence from merged instrumentation (Gerrit 1793, run 31846417650) ruled out worker starvation, tmp_path overhead, and _no_repo_commits fixture as causes, isolating the defect to CPython reverse-DNS behavior in loopback address initialization.
